spots.name: Untitled mural
spots.blurb: You're at a mural that has been mapped here. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: La Cabra
spots.blurb: You've reached La Cabra, a mural. Under a Spanish flag, a narrow stepped alley descends between the facades of white-washed Spanish houses, stretching into an early evening sky.
